metadata.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 excerpt (AC-2, AU-6, IA-2)
metadata.remarks: Abridged from NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5 for examples and tests.

params.label: prerequisites and criteria for group and role membership
personnel or roles required to approve requests to create accounts

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Define and document the types of accounts allowed and specifically prohibited for use within the system;

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Require {{ insert: param, ac-02_odp.01 }} for group and role membership;

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Require approvals by {{ insert: param, ac-02_odp.02 }} for requests to create accounts;

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Review accounts for compliance with account management requirements {{ insert: param, ac-02_odp.03 }};

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting

params.label: personnel or roles to receive findings

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Review and analyze system audit records {{ insert: param, au-06_odp.01 }} for indications of {{ insert: param, au-06_odp.02 }} and the potential impact of the inappropriate or unusual activity;

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Report findings to {{ insert: param, au-06_odp.03 }}; and

parts.name: item
parts.prose: Adjust the level of audit record review, analysis, and reporting within the system when there is a change in risk based on law enforcement information, intelligence information, or other credible sources of information.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.
